name: cloud-monitoring-chart-generation
description: Generates Google Cloud Monitoring Server-Driven UI (SDUI) Widget and XyChart Protocol Buffer textprotos from resolved PromQL or ListTimeSeries queries. Use when: - Generating valid google.monitoring.dashboard.v1.Widget textprotos, containing PrometheusQuery or TimeSeriesFilter datasets, for use with the Cloud Monitoring Dashboards API, gcloud CLI, or declarative dashboard definitions. - Synthesizing Server-Driven UI (SDUI) widget titles, axis labels, and plot types for Prometheus or ListTimeSeries queries. Don't use for: - Metric discovery or PromQL query generation. For those tasks, use the cloud-monitoring-metric-selection or cloud-monitoring-promql-query skills.
